group-2022-jia-seven-choices.overview: 本文是一篇说明文，介绍世界各地外出就餐时需要了解的文化餐桌礼节。文章用小标题分块，分别讲筷子礼节、用手还是用餐具、提出要求三类情境，最后落到一条总规律。七选五的五个空分布在引言句、各分项段落与结尾，分别考查主旨概括、指代衔接、并列转折与“the more…the more”结构。

discourseStructure.summary: 全文以“各地餐桌礼节差异大、了解一些技巧就能愉快用餐”开篇，随后用三个小标题（筷子礼节、用手还是用餐具、提出要求）分类列举不同国家的具体禁忌，结尾段落点出这些规则虽看似随意却很重要，并给出“在一个国家待得越久，就越能适应其文化习俗”的总结。

units.heading: Important Things to Know When Dining Out
units.summary: 引言：各国餐桌礼节规则可能出乎意料，掌握一些技巧就能在任何地方愉快用餐。

units.heading: Chopstick Rules
units.summary: 筷子礼节：放下筷子要并拢、与桌沿平行，且不可竖插食物或交叉摆放。

units.heading: Hands or Utensils
units.summary: 用手还是用餐具：印度、中东忌用左手，法国双手各持餐具，墨西哥认为用餐具不妥而偏好用手，智利忌用手指碰食物，泰国用叉把食物推到勺上。

units.heading: Making Requests
units.summary: 提出要求：要盐和胡椒看似简单，但在葡萄牙是大忌，在意大利也绝不要额外加奶酪。
结尾：这些规则看似随意却很重要，在一个国家待得越久，就越能适应其异域文化习俗。

topicClues: no matter where you are in the world

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: might surprise you with some of its important rules.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: Knowing some tips will help ensure that you have an enjoyable meal with friends or family

mechanismSignals.relation: 选项中 mistake at a restaurant 与空前 dining etiquette、important rules 同属外出就餐礼节话题场。

mechanismSignals.targetText: Don't get caught making an embarrassing mistake
mechanismSignals.relation: 空前 important rules 提示“违反规则会出错”，引出选项的“别犯尴尬错误”这一主旨提醒。

mechanismSignals.targetText: Don't get caught making an embarrassing mistake
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后 Knowing some tips 承接“别出错”的提醒，构成“别犯错→掌握技巧即可避免”的话题衔接。

optionFit.fitSummary: 空前指出各国餐桌礼节有重要规则，空后说掌握技巧就能愉快用餐，选项D“别在餐厅犯尴尬错误”正好充当承上启下的主旨提醒，与前后话题严密对接。

matchedClues.optionSide: an embarrassing mistake at a restaurant
matchedClues.relation: 违反 dining etiquette 的 rules 即会在餐厅犯下令人尴尬的错误，话题一致。

matchedClues.contextSide: Knowing some tips will help ensure
matchedClues.optionSide: Don't get caught making an embarrassing mistake
matchedClues.relation: 空后用 tips 来“避免出错”，正回应选项提出的“别犯尴尬错误”。

keyDistractors.reason: A“一生中结交的朋友越多”是 the more…the more 结构，且话题为交友，与本段就餐礼节、空后非比较句均不符。

q-2022-jia-036.teachingNote: 引言段空格常是全文主旨句，应抓前后核心话题词（dining etiquette / rules / tips）锁定与之同场的选项。

topicClues: parallel with the edge of the table

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: always put them down together so they are parallel with the edge of the table in front of you.

mechanismSignals.relation: 选项中两个 them 均指代本段反复出现的 chopsticks，靠代词回指完成衔接。
空前 chopsticks 是选项中 them 的先行词。

mechanismSignals.targetText: Never stick them upright / cross them
mechanismSignals.relation: 空前讲正确摆放筷子的方式，选项以 Never…upright / cross 补充禁忌摆法，同属筷子摆放话题。

optionFit.fitSummary: 本段在讲筷子的正确摆放方式，选项F“切勿把筷子竖插食物或交叉摆放”用代词them回指chopsticks，正好补充该话题下的禁忌，置于段末顺理成章。

matchedClues.contextSide: The way you handle chopsticks / put them down together
matchedClues.optionSide: Never stick them upright in your food or cross them
matchedClues.relation: 前句给出该怎样摆，选项给出不该怎样摆，正反互补于同一话题。
选项的 them 必须有复数先行词，唯有本段 chopsticks 满足。

q-2022-jia-037.teachingNote: 段末空若选项含代词them/they，先回头找复数先行词，本段唯一的复数名词chopsticks即锁定答案。

topicClues: touch any food with your fingers

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: People in France expect you to eat with a utensil in each hand.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: instead preferring to use their hands.

mechanismSignals.relation: 空后 instead 表示“反而、转而”，要求空格句先否定用餐具，选项C正给出“认为用餐具不妥”这一被替代项。
选项 with utensils 与空后 use their hands 形成餐具—用手的对立，正是 instead 所连接的两端。
空后“偏好用手”与选项“认为用餐具不妥”话题对应，且 their 与选项主语 Mexicans 一致。

optionFit.fitSummary: 空后用instead preferring to use their hands，要求前面先说“某国人不用餐具”，选项C“墨西哥人认为用餐具不妥”恰为被instead替代的对象，逻辑连接严密。

matchedClues.contextSide: instead preferring to use their hands
matchedClues.optionSide: Mexicans consider it inappropriate to eat with utensils
matchedClues.relation: instead 连接“反对用餐具”与“转而用手”，两端话题正好对立互补。
空后物主代词 their 需以复数群体作先行词，选项主语 Mexicans 满足且语义连贯。

keyDistractors.reason: E谈“弄乱盘子周围对厨师是好兆头”，与本段“用手还是用餐具”话题及 instead 的逻辑都不搭。

q-2022-jia-038.teachingNote: 看到空后的 instead，要在空格句里找出被它替代、与空后形成对立的那一项，据此锁定选项。

topicClues: this would be a serious mistake

contextEvidence.afterQuote: In Portugal, this would be a serious mistake, because it shows the chef that you don’t like their seasoning skills.

mechanismSignals.targetText: to ask for salt and pepper at a meal
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后 this 指代选项中“要盐和胡椒”这一请求，靠指示代词回指完成段首衔接。
选项 salt and pepper 属于调味 seasoning 话题场，正解释空后“嫌厨师调味不好”。

mechanismSignals.targetText: ask for salt and pepper at a meal
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后 seasoning skills 与选项加盐加胡椒同属调味话题，呼应小标题 Making Requests。

optionFit.fitSummary: 本段以小标题Making Requests开头，空后用this指代某个请求并说在葡萄牙是大忌，选项G“在用餐时要盐和胡椒看似是个简单请求”正是this的所指，且salt and pepper对应seasoning skills。

matchedClues.contextSide: this would be a serious mistake / seasoning skills
matchedClues.optionSide: to ask for salt and pepper at a meal
matchedClues.relation: 要盐和胡椒即对厨师调味提出异议，正是空后所说的“严重错误”，this 回指该请求。

matchedClues.optionSide: It may seem like a simple request
matchedClues.relation: 选项中的 request 直接呼应小标题 Making Requests，作段首主题句。

q-2022-jia-039.teachingNote: 段首空可借空后的指示代词this反向定位——找出this具体指代的那个请求/动作，对应选项即为答案。

topicClues: the more comfortable you'll begin to feel

contextEvidence.beforeQuote: but they are important in various countries.
contextEvidence.afterQuote: the more comfortable you’ll begin to feel with its foreign cultural practices.

mechanismSignals.targetText: the more comfortable you'll begin to feel
mechanismSignals.relation: 选项以 The more 开头，与空后 the more comfortable 构成“the more…the more…”比较结构，前后两半必须配套。

mechanismSignals.targetText: The more time you spend in any given country
mechanismSignals.relation: 空后 the more comfortable 是结构后半句，要求空格填入以 The more 引导的前半句。
选项 country 与空后 its foreign cultural practices 中的 its 指代一致，话题对接到“某国的文化习俗”。

optionFit.fitSummary: 空后是the more comfortable you'll begin to feel，构成“the more…the more…”句式的后半句，选项B“你在某个国家待得越久”正是配套的前半句，且country与its foreign cultural practices语义一致。

matchedClues.contextSide: the more comfortable you'll begin to feel
matchedClues.optionSide: The more time you spend in any given country
matchedClues.relation: 待的时间越久（因）→ 越自在（果），完整组成 the more…the more 越…越…结构。
空后 its 指代选项中的 country，文化习俗归属于该国，指代连贯。

keyDistractors.reason: A“你一生结交的朋友越多”同为 The more 结构，但话题是交友，与空后“越发适应某国文化习俗”因果不通，故排除。

q-2022-jia-040.teachingNote: 看到空后是 the more + 形容词，立即判定为“the more…the more…”句式，从含 The more 的选项中按话题（待得越久→越适应该国文化）择优。
